messages:
maria_fin: Partner R-3321 sent a credit note for $12,400 referencing AWS settlement MKT-98765. Our invoice run only shows -$12,150. Anyone know why there's a $250 gap?
ajay_sales: They attached a short CSV and the PDF to partners@. They say it's a single line credit. I asked them to upload the full export.
aws_billing_bot: Notice: Settlement MKT-98765 posted 2026-03-18. Details at console link.
maria_fin: Pulled payer ledger: -$12,150 appears as settlement adjustment. Could be tax, fees, or reversed tax line.
lina_rev: Revenue impact question 12K credit to reseller. We need evidence before we book contra revenue. Request full CSV + proof that AWS reversed $12,400 to our payer.
greg_ops: AWS exports sometimes split tax into separate rows. If the partner CSV only showed one row it might have omitted tax detail.
ajay_sales: Partner uploaded full CSV and screenshot to shared folder: https://files.redwood.com/partners/R-3321/MKT-98765-full.csv
maria_fin: Got it. Full CSV shows two lines: -12,150 product credit + -250 sales tax reversal = -12,400 total. That reconciles the numbers.
lina_rev: Ok to proceed. Revenue code 4002 (contra-marketplace), tax code TXR-01. Maria, prepare credit memo to reseller for $12,400 and attach AWS export + screenshot + support case id.
maria_fin: Will issue CM-20260319-778, apply to next invoice cycle, and post journal on 2026-03-20. Closing once applied.
ajay_sales: Confirmed partner will be notified. :white_check_mark:
